controls.title: Establish AI policy
controls.description: Define and document an AI governance policy that aligns with organizational objectives and legal requirements.

controls.title: Leadership commitment
controls.description: Ensure top management demonstrates leadership and commitment to the AI management system.
controls.reason: Our org doesn’t deploy AI in customer-facing products yet.

controls.title: Scope of the AI MS
controls.description: Determine and document the boundaries and applicability of the AI management system.

controls.title: Roles and responsibilities
controls.description: Define the roles, responsibilities, and authorities for AI governance, implementation, and oversight.

controls.title: Risk assessment process
controls.description: Implement a structured process to identify, analyze and evaluate AI-related risks.

controls.title: Risk treatment plan
controls.description: Define and document how identified AI risks will be treated, accepted, transferred or avoided.

controls.title: Risk acceptance criteria
controls.description: Establish and document criteria for determining which risks are acceptable.

controls.title: Risk monitoring and review
controls.description: Continuously monitor and review AI risks and the effectiveness of risk treatment measures.

controls.title: Monitoring and measurement
controls.description: Establish metrics, methods and frequency for monitoring and measuring AI MS performance.

controls.title: Internal audit
controls.description: Conduct internal audits at planned intervals to ensure the AI MS conforms to requirements.

controls.title: Management review
controls.description: Top management shall review the AI MS at planned intervals for suitability, adequacy and effectiveness.

controls.title: Continuous improvement
controls.description: Identify opportunities for improvement and take actions to enhance the AI MS performance.
